payload.core_mechanism_summary: Exhaustively iterate over all possible split indices (i,j) to partition the string into three non-empty numbers, validate each (no leading zeros, ≤1e6), and track the maximum sum.
payload.rationale: The solution does not use bounding or pruning, just loops over all pairs of cut points. Among the given subtypes, backtracking best captures the exhaustive combinatorial exploration, even though implementation is iterative. Branch and bound, bitmask, graph, or permutation enumeration do not fit.
